// src/activity.ts
import type { ActivityKind, ActivityRepository, BackgroundActivity, Clock } from "./ports";
export type ActivityDeps = {
    clock: Clock;
    activities: ActivityRepository;
};
export type ActivityProgress = {
    advance(): Promise<void>;
    end(): Promise<void>;
};
export type CurrentActivity = Pick<BackgroundActivity, "kind" | "done" | "total">;
export declare function createActivityLog(deps: ActivityDeps): {
    begin(kind: ActivityKind, total: number): Promise<ActivityProgress>;
    current(): Promise<CurrentActivity | null>;
};
export type ActivityLog = ReturnType<typeof createActivityLog>;
// src/admin-access.ts
import { type AdminId, type Email } from "@family-agenda/domain";
import type { AdminRepository, AdminSessionRepository, Clock, FamilyRepository, PasswordHasher, SignInFailureLog } from "./ports";
export declare const sessionLifetimeMs: number;
export declare const signInLimits: {
    windowMs: number;
    perAccount: number;
    perClient: number;
};
export type AdminAccessDeps = {
    clock: Clock;
    passwordHasher: PasswordHasher;
    families: FamilyRepository;
    admins: AdminRepository;
    sessions: AdminSessionRepository;
    signInFailures: SignInFailureLog;
};
export type AdminSummary = {
    id: AdminId;
    email: Email;
};
export type AccountProblem = "invalid-email" | "password-too-short";
export type CreateFirstAdminResult = {
    ok: true;
    sessionToken: string;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: AccountProblem | "admin-exists" | "invalid-language";
};
export type SignInResult = {
    ok: true;
    sessionToken: string;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "invalid-credentials" | "rate-limited";
};
export type IdentitySignInResult = {
    ok: true;
    sessionToken: string;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "identity-email-unverified" | "identity-conflict";
};
export type PasswordResetResult = {
    ok: true;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "password-too-short" | "own-account" | "unknown-admin";
};
export declare function createAdminAccess(deps: AdminAccessDeps): {
    needsFirstAdmin(): Promise<boolean>;
    createFirstAdmin(input: {
        email: string;
        password: string;
        language?: string;
    }): Promise<CreateFirstAdminResult>;
    signIn(input: {
        email: string;
        password: string;
        client: string;
    }): Promise<SignInResult>;
    signInThroughIdentityProvider(identity: {
        subject: string;
        email: string | null;
        emailVerified: boolean;
    }): Promise<IdentitySignInResult>;
    signOut(sessionToken: string): Promise<void>;
    listAdmins(): Promise<AdminSummary[]>;
    createAdmin(input: {
        email: string;
        password: string;
    }): Promise<{
        ok: true;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        problem: AccountProblem | "email-taken";
    }>;
    resetPassword(actor: AdminSummary, input: {
        adminId: AdminId;
        newPassword: string;
    }): Promise<PasswordResetResult>;
    resetPasswordByEmail(input: {
        email: string;
        newPassword: string;
    }): Promise<PasswordResetResult>;
    authenticate(sessionToken: string): Promise<AdminSummary | null>;
};
export type AdminAccess = ReturnType<typeof createAdminAccess>;

// src/catalogues.ts
import { type MultilingualText, type SourceTypeId } from "@family-agenda/domain";
import type { CatalogueEntrySpec, CatalogueRepository, LoadedSourceType, SourceTypeRegistry, SourceTypeRepository } from "./ports";
import { type DisableResult, type EnableResult } from "./enablement";
export type CataloguesDeps = {
    registry: SourceTypeRegistry;
    sourceTypes: SourceTypeRepository;
    catalogues: CatalogueRepository;
};
export type CatalogueEntrySummary = CatalogueEntrySpec & {
    enabled: boolean;
    pollIntervalSeconds: number | null;
};
export type CatalogueSummary = {
    sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId;
    title: MultilingualText;
    entries: CatalogueEntrySummary[];
};
declare const problems: {
    readonly unknown: "unknown-entry";
    readonly unavailable: "not-installed";
    readonly inUse: "entry-in-use";
};
export declare function usableEntries(sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId, sourceType: LoadedSourceType, catalogues: CatalogueRepository): Promise<CatalogueEntrySpec[]>;
export declare function createCatalogueAccess(deps: CataloguesDeps): {
    start(): Promise<void>;
    list(): Promise<CatalogueSummary[]>;
    enable(sourceTypeId: string, entryId: string, input?: {
        riskAcknowledged?: boolean;
    }): Promise<EnableResult<typeof problems>>;
    setPollInterval(sourceTypeId: string, entryId: string, seconds: number | null): Promise<{
        ok: true;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        problem: "unknown-entry" | "invalid-interval";
    }>;
    disable(sourceTypeId: string, entryId: string): Promise<DisableResult<typeof problems>>;
};
export type CatalogueAccess = ReturnType<typeof createCatalogueAccess>;
export {};

// src/enablement.ts
import type { MultilingualText } from "@family-agenda/domain";
export type Enableable = {
    available(): Promise<boolean>;
    riskNotice: MultilingualText | null;
    enable(): Promise<boolean>;
    disableIfUnused(): Promise<boolean>;
};
export type EnablementProblems = {
    unknown: string;
    unavailable: string;
    inUse: string;
};
export type EnableResult<P extends EnablementProblems> = {
    ok: true;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: P["unknown"] | P["unavailable"] | "risk-not-acknowledged";
};
export type DisableResult<P extends EnablementProblems> = {
    ok: true;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: P["unknown"] | P["inUse"];
};
export declare function enableIfAllowed<P extends EnablementProblems>(candidate: Enableable | null, input: {
    riskAcknowledged?: boolean;
}, problems: P): Promise<EnableResult<P>>;
export declare function disableIfUnused<P extends EnablementProblems>(candidate: Enableable | null, problems: P): Promise<DisableResult<P>>;

    endpoints: LlmEndpointRepository;

    sources: SourceRepository;
    blobs: BlobStore;
    extractor: Extractor;
    textExtractor: TextExtractor;
    ocrModels: OcrModelStore;
    activity: ActivityLog;
};
export type ExtractionReport = {
    extracted: RawMessageId[];
    dropped: {
        messageId: RawMessageId;
        title: string | null;
        problem: string;
    }[];
    failed: {
        messageId: RawMessageId;
        problem: Extract<ExtractionResult, {
            ok: false;
        }>["problem"];
        message: string;
    }[];
};
export declare const extractionBackoffMs: number;
export declare function createExtraction(deps: ExtractionDeps): {
    waiting(scope?: {
        sourceId?: SourceId;
    }): Promise<number>;

};
export type ExtractionAccess = ReturnType<typeof createExtraction>;

    initial: string;
    hasPhoto: boolean;
};

export type RemoveResult = {
    ok: true;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "sole-assignee";
    blocking: SoleAssignment[];
};

    ok: true;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: FamilyMemberProblem | "unknown-member";
};

    list(): Promise<FamilyMemberSummary[]>;

        name: string;
        photo?: Uint8Array;

        ok: true;
        id: FamilyMemberId;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        problem: FamilyMemberProblem;
    }>;
    edit(id: FamilyMemberId, input: {
        name: string;
        photo?: Uint8Array | null;
    }): Promise<EditResult>;
    remove(id: FamilyMemberId): Promise<RemoveResult>;
    photo(id: FamilyMemberId): Promise<{
        bytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;

    } | null>;
};

// src/polling.ts
import type { SourceId } from "@family-agenda/domain";
import type { ActivityLog } from "./activity";
import type { BlobStore, CatalogueRepository, Clock, ItemRepository, SecretStore, SourceRepository, SourceTypeRegistry, SourceTypeRepository } from "./ports";
export declare const pollsPerSourceType = 2;
export declare const maximumBackoffMs: number;
export type PollingDeps = {
    clock: Clock;
    timeZone: string;
    registry: SourceTypeRegistry;
    sourceTypes: SourceTypeRepository;
    catalogues: CatalogueRepository;
    sources: SourceRepository;
    secrets: SecretStore;
    items: ItemRepository;
    blobs: BlobStore;
    activity: ActivityLog;
    pluginTimeoutMs?: number;
};
export type PollReport = {
    polled: SourceId[];
    failed: {
        sourceId: SourceId;
        kind: "definite" | "temporary";
        message: string;
    }[];
    invalid: {
        sourceId: SourceId;
        externalId: string;
        problems: string[];
    }[];
    refused: {
        sourceId: SourceId;
        attributes: string[];
    }[];
};
export declare function createSourcePolling(deps: PollingDeps): {
    nextDueAt(): Promise<Date | null>;
    pollDue(): Promise<PollReport>;
};
export type SourcePolling = ReturnType<typeof createSourcePolling>;
// src/ports.ts
import type { Admin, DateMention, BlobRef, AdminId, Email, FamilyLanguages, FamilyMember, FamilyMemberId, Event, ItemId, Lesson, LocalDate, LocalTime, MultilingualText, OcrLanguage, RawMessageId, RunError, SourceFailure, SourceAttributeId, SourceId, SourceTypeId, StatedTask, Task, TimetableChange, Agenda, AgendaId } from "@family-agenda/domain";
export interface Clock {
    now(): Date;
}
export interface PasswordHasher {
    hash(password: string): Promise<string>;
    verify(hash: string, password: string): Promise<boolean>;
}
export interface FamilyRepository {
    recoveryKitConfirmed(): Promise<boolean>;
    confirmRecoveryKit(at: Date): Promise<void>;
    languages(): Promise<FamilyLanguages>;

    ocrEnabled(): Promise<boolean>;
    saveOcrEnabled(enabled: boolean): Promise<void>;
}
export interface AdminRepository {
    exists(): Promise<boolean>;
    addFirst(admin: Admin): Promise<boolean>;
    add(admin: Admin): Promise<boolean>;
    findById(id: AdminId): Promise<Admin | null>;
    findByEmail(email: Email): Promise<Admin | null>;
    findByIdentitySubject(subject: string): Promise<Admin | null>;
    list(): Promise<Admin[]>;
    setPasswordHash(id: AdminId, passwordHash: string): Promise<void>;
    setIdentitySubject(id: AdminId, subject: string): Promise<void>;
}
export interface FamilyMemberRepository {
    add(member: FamilyMember): Promise<void>;
    list(): Promise<FamilyMember[]>;
    findById(id: FamilyMemberId): Promise<FamilyMember | null>;
    update(member: FamilyMember): Promise<void>;
    remove(id: FamilyMemberId): Promise<{
        removed: true;
    } | {
        removed: false;
        blocking: SoleAssignment[];
    }>;
}
export type SoleAssignment = {
    sourceId: SourceId;
    attribute: string;
};
export interface AgendaRepository {
    add(agenda: Agenda): Promise<void>;
    list(): Promise<Agenda[]>;

}

    adminId: AdminId;

};

}
export interface SignInFailureLog {

    forget(ids: string[]): Promise<void>;
    countAfter(key: string, after: Date): Promise<number>;

}
export type SecretRef = string & {
    readonly __brand: "SecretRef";
};
export interface SecretStore {
    put(plaintext: string): Promise<SecretRef>;
    get(ref: SecretRef): Promise<string | null>;
    remove(ref: SecretRef): Promise<void>;
    list(): Promise<{
        ref: SecretRef;
        storedAt: Date;
    }[]>;
}
export interface BlobStore {
    put(contents: Uint8Array): Promise<BlobRef>;
    get(ref: BlobRef): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> | null>;
    remove(ref: BlobRef): Promise<void>;
}
export type InstalledSourceType = {
    id: SourceTypeId;
    displayName: MultilingualText;
    description: MultilingualText;
    version: string;
    needsLlm: boolean;
    riskNotice: MultilingualText | null;
    notLoadable: string | null;
};
export type PlainConfig = Record<string, unknown>;
export type ConfigFieldSpec = {
    key: string;
    label: MultilingualText;
    secret: boolean;
    required: boolean;
    description: MultilingualText | null;
    setByPlugin: boolean;
    choice: boolean;
};
export type SetupStepSpec = {
    id: string;
    title: MultilingualText;
    description: MultilingualText;
    live: boolean;
};
export type SetupProgress = {
    status: "waiting";
    qrCode: string | null;
    message: MultilingualText | null;
} | {
    status: "done";
    message: MultilingualText | null;
} | {
    status: "failed";
    message: MultilingualText;
};
export type CatalogueEntrySpec = {
    id: string;
    displayName: MultilingualText;
    description: MultilingualText;
    installed: boolean;
    riskNotice: MultilingualText | null;
};
export type CatalogueSpec = {
    title: MultilingualText;
    configKey: string;
    entries(): Promise<CatalogueEntrySpec[]>;
};
export type ServicesSpec = {
    reconcile(enabled: {
        enabled: boolean;
        entries: string[];
    }): Promise<void>;
    stop(): Promise<void>;
};
export type SourceRunContext = {
    plain: PlainConfig;
    secrets: Record<string, string>;
    syncCursor: string | null;
    now: Date;
    timeZone: string;
};
export type StatedJson = Record<string, unknown>;
export type IngestedAttachment = {
    filename: string;
    contentType: string;
    bytes: Uint8Array;
};
export type IngestedMessage = {
    text: string;
    attachments: IngestedAttachment[];
};
export type IngestedOrigin = {
    externalId: string;
    occurredAt: Date | null;
    attributes: string[];
    sender: string | null;
    subject: string | null;
    link: string | null;
    stated: StatedJson | null;
    message: IngestedMessage | null;
};
export type SourceRunResult = {
    ok: true;
    declared: DeclaredAttribute[];
    archived: string[];
    origins: IngestedOrigin[];
    syncCursor: string | null;
    withdrawn: string[];
} | {
    ok: false;
    kind: "definite" | "temporary";
    message: string;
};
export type DeclaredAttribute = {
    externalId: string;
    name: string;
};
export type PollingIngestion = {
    mode: "polling";
    suggestedIntervalSeconds: number;
    poll(context: SourceRunContext): Promise<SourceRunResult>;
};
export type LoadedSourceType = {
    configuration: {
        version: number;
        fields: ConfigFieldSpec[];
    };
    setupSteps: SetupStepSpec[];
    ingestion: PollingIngestion | {
        mode: "push";
    };
    silentApplies: boolean;
    catalogue: CatalogueSpec | null;
    services: ServicesSpec | null;
    choices(key: string, context: SourceRunContext): Promise<KnownValue[]>;
    setupProgress(stepId: string, context: SourceRunContext): Promise<SetupProgress>;
    sourceAdded(context: Omit<SourceRunContext, "syncCursor">): Promise<{
        ok: true;
        plain: PlainConfig;
        secrets: Record<string, string>;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        message: string;
    }>;
    sourceRemoved(context: SourceRunContext): Promise<void>;
};
export type KnownValue = {
    value: string;
    label: string;
};
export interface SourceTypeRegistry {
    installed(): InstalledSourceType[];
    load(id: SourceTypeId): Promise<{
        ok: true;
        sourceType: LoadedSourceType;
    } | {
        ok: false;
    }>;
    migrateConfig(id: SourceTypeId, plain: PlainConfig, fromVersion: number): Promise<{
        ok: true;
        plain: PlainConfig;
        configVersion: number;
    } | {
        ok: false;
    }>;
}
export type SourceTypeRecord = {
    id: SourceTypeId;
    enabled: boolean;
};
export type CatalogueRecord = {
    entryId: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    pollIntervalSeconds: number | null;
};
export interface CatalogueRepository {
    recordDiscovered(sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId, entryIds: string[]): Promise<void>;
    list(sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId): Promise<CatalogueRecord[]>;
    enable(sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId, entryId: string): Promise<void>;
    setPollInterval(sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId, entryId: string, seconds: number | null): Promise<void>;
    disableIfUnused(sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId, entryId: string, configKey: string): Promise<boolean>;
}
export interface SourceTypeRepository {
    recordDiscovered(ids: SourceTypeId[]): Promise<void>;
    list(): Promise<SourceTypeRecord[]>;
    enable(id: SourceTypeId): Promise<void>;
    disableIfUnused(id: SourceTypeId): Promise<boolean>;
}
export type Source = {
    id: SourceId;
    sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId;
    plain: PlainConfig;
    configVersion: number;
    secrets: Record<string, SecretRef>;
    syncCursor: string | null;
    pollIntervalSeconds: number | null;
    shown: boolean;
    name: string | null;
    attributes: SourceAttribute[];
    lastRunAt: Date | null;
    lastSuccessAt: Date | null;
    failure: SourceFailure | null;
    consecutiveFailures: number;
    lastNewRecordAt: Date | null;
    invalidRecords: string[];
    unknownAttributes: string[];
    createdAt: Date;
};
export type SourceAttribute = {
    id: SourceAttributeId;
    externalId: string;
    name: string;
    archived: boolean;
    concerns: FamilyMemberId[];
};
export interface SourceRepository {
    add(source: Source): Promise<void>;
    list(): Promise<Source[]>;
    listOfType(sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId): Promise<Source[]>;
    findById(id: SourceId): Promise<Source | null>;
    migrateConfig(id: SourceId, fromVersion: number, plain: PlainConfig, configVersion: number): Promise<void>;
    update(source: Source): Promise<void>;
    recordFailedRun(id: SourceId, at: Date, error: RunError): Promise<void>;
    lease(id: SourceId, lease: {
        now: Date;
        until: Date;
        lastRunAt: Date | null;
    }): Promise<boolean>;
    release(id: SourceId, until: Date): Promise<void>;
    recordFailedExtraction(id: SourceId, at: Date): Promise<void>;
    setShown(id: SourceId, shown: boolean): Promise<void>;
    rename(id: SourceId, name: string | null): Promise<void>;
    declareAttributes(id: SourceId, attributes: DeclaredAttribute[]): Promise<void>;
    archiveAttribute(id: SourceId, externalId: string): Promise<void>;
    assignAttribute(id: SourceAttributeId, concerns: FamilyMemberId[]): Promise<boolean>;
    remove(id: SourceId): Promise<BlobRef[]>;
}
export type StatedItem = {
    kind: "event";
    event: Event;
} | {
    kind: "lesson";
    lesson: Omit<Lesson, "cancelled">;
    change: StoredChange | null;
} | {
    kind: "task";
    task: StatedTask;
};
export type StoredChange = Pick<TimetableChange, "change" | "previousRoom" | "previousTeacher" | "note">;
export type ReadStated = (stated: StatedJson) => {
    ok: true;
    item: StatedItem;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problems: string[];
};
export type InvalidRecord = {
    externalId: string;
    problems: string[];
};
export type StoredFile = {
    blob: BlobRef;
    sha256: string;
    size: number;
};
export type StoredMessage = {
    sender: string | null;
    subject: string | null;
    body: string;
    attachments: (StoredFile & {
        filename: string;
        contentType: string;
    })[];
};
export type SourceRun = {
    sourceId: SourceId;
    at: Date;
    syncCursor: string | null;
    retainedSince: Date;
    withdrawn: string[];
    origins: {
        externalId: string;
        occurredAt: Date | null;
        attributes: string[];
        sender: string | null;
        subject: string | null;
        link: string | null;
        stated: StatedJson | null;
        message: StoredMessage | null;
    }[];
};
export type RunRecorded = {
    knownMessages: string[];
    withdrawnFiles: BlobRef[];
    invalid: InvalidRecord[];
    refused: string[];
};
export type PendingMessage = {
    id: RawMessageId;
    sourceId: SourceId;
    sentAt: Date;
    body: string;
    attachments: PendingAttachment[];
};
export type PendingAttachment = {
    position: number;
    filename: string;
    contentType: string;
    blob: BlobRef;
};
export type RawMessage = {
    id: RawMessageId;
    sourceId: SourceId;
    sentAt: Date;
    sender: string | null;
    subject: string | null;
    attributes: string[];
    body: string;
    purgedAt: Date | null;
    attachments: {
        position: number;
        filename: string;
        contentType: string;
        size: number;
        blob: BlobRef;
        conversionProblem: string | null;
    }[];
};
export type NewItem = {
    kind: "event";
    event: Event;
} | {
    kind: "task";
    task: StatedTask;
};
export type Extraction = {
    messageId: RawMessageId;
    at: Date;
    items: NewItem[];
    attachmentProblems: AttachmentProblem[];
};
export type AttachmentProblem = {
    position: number;
    problem: string;
};
export type ItemDetails = {
    kind: "event";
    event: Event;
} | {
    kind: "task";
    task: Task;
} | {
    kind: "lesson";
    lesson: Lesson;
    change: TimetableChange | null;
};
export type ProjectedItem = ItemDetails & {
    id: ItemId;
    links: {
        url: string;
        sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId;
        sourceName: string | null;
    }[];
    messages: {
        id: RawMessageId;
        sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId;
        sourceName: string | null;
        sentAt: Date;
    }[];
    assignments: FamilyMemberId[][];
};
export interface ItemRepository {
    recordRun(run: SourceRun, read: ReadStated): Promise<RunRecorded>;
    purgeMessages(now: Date, retainedSince: Date): Promise<{
        files: BlobRef[];
        purged: number;
        deleted: number;
    }>;
    pendingMessages(limit: number, failedAfter: Date): Promise<PendingMessage[]>;
    pendingExtractionFailures(): Promise<(Date | null)[]>;
    pendingMessageCount(scope: {
        sourceId?: SourceId;
    }): Promise<number>;
    recordExtraction(extraction: Extraction): Promise<void>;
    findMessage(id: RawMessageId): Promise<RawMessage | null>;
    itemsOfMessage(id: RawMessageId): Promise<ProjectedItem[]>;
    overlapping(from: Date, to: Date | null): Promise<ProjectedItem[]>;
    outstanding(): Promise<ProjectedItem[]>;
    find(id: ItemId): Promise<ProjectedItem | null>;
    setTaskDone(id: ItemId, at: Date | null): Promise<void>;
    remove(id: ItemId): Promise<boolean>;
}
export type LlmEndpoint = {
    baseUrl: string;
    model: string;
    apiKey: string | null;
};
export type StoredLlmEndpoint = {
    baseUrl: string;

    apiKey: SecretRef | null;
    acknowledgedAt: Date | null;
    savedAt: Date;
};
export interface LlmEndpointRepository {

}
export type StoredIdentityProvider = {
    enabled: boolean;

    savedAt: Date;
};
export interface IdentityProviderRepository {

export type IdentityProviderConnection = {
    issuerUrl: string;
    clientId: string;
    clientSecret: string;
};
export type PendingSignIn = {
    state: string;
    nonce: string;
    codeVerifier: string;
};
export type VerifiedIdentity = {
    subject: string;
    email: string | null;
    emailVerified: boolean;
    groups: string[];
};
export interface IdentityProviderClient {
    discover(issuerUrl: string): Promise<{
        ok: true;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        message: string;
    }>;
    begin(connection: IdentityProviderConnection, redirectUri: string): Promise<{
        authorizationUrl: string;
        pending: PendingSignIn;
    }>;
    complete(connection: IdentityProviderConnection, redirectUri: string, callbackUrl: string, pending: PendingSignIn): Promise<VerifiedIdentity | null>;
}
export type ExtractedEvent = {
    title: string | null;
    date: DateMention;
    startTime: string | null;
    endTime: string | null;
    place: string | null;
    evidence: string;
};
export type ExtractedTask = {
    title: string | null;
    deadline: DateMention;
    bring: string[];
    evidence: string;
};
export type ExtractionRequest = {
    endpoint: LlmEndpoint;
    message: {
        text: string;
        sent: {
            date: LocalDate;
            time: LocalTime;
            weekday: string;
        };
    };
};
export type EndpointFailure = {
    ok: false;
    problem: "unreachable" | "unauthorized" | "invalid-output";
    message: string;
};
export type ExtractionResult = {
    ok: true;
    events: ExtractedEvent[];
    tasks: ExtractedTask[];
} | EndpointFailure;
export interface Extractor {
    extract(request: ExtractionRequest): Promise<ExtractionResult>;
    health(endpoint: LlmEndpoint): Promise<EndpointHealth>;
    models(endpoint: LlmEndpoint): Promise<string[]>;
}
export type EndpointHealth = {
    ok: true;
} | {
    ok: false;
    message: string;
};
export type Conversion<T> = {
    ok: true;
    value: T;
} | {
    ok: false;
    message: string;
};
export interface TextExtractor {
    textLayer(pdf: Uint8Array): Promise<Conversion<string[]>>;
    ocr(pdf: Uint8Array, pages: number[], languages: OcrLanguage[]): Promise<Conversion<string[]>>;
}
export type OcrModel = {
    language: OcrLanguage;
    bundled: boolean;
};
export interface OcrModelStore {
    downloadable(): OcrLanguage[];
    installed(): Promise<OcrModel[]>;
    install(language: OcrLanguage): Promise<Conversion<null>>;
    remove(language: OcrLanguage): Promise<void>;
}

import { type FamilyMemberId, type MultilingualText, type SourceAttributeId, type SourceId, type SourceTypeId } from "@family-agenda/domain";
import type { BlobStore, CatalogueRepository, Clock, ConfigFieldSpec, FamilyMemberRepository, KnownValue, PlainConfig, SecretStore, SetupProgress, SetupStepSpec, Source, SourceAttribute, SourceRepository, SourceRunContext, SourceTypeRegistry, SourceTypeRepository } from "./ports";
import { type SourceHealth } from "./source-health";
export type SourcesDeps = {
    clock: Clock;
    members: FamilyMemberRepository;
    registry: SourceTypeRegistry;
    sourceTypes: SourceTypeRepository;
    catalogues: CatalogueRepository;
    sources: SourceRepository;
    secrets: SecretStore;
    blobs: BlobStore;
    timeZone: string;
};
export type SourceSummary = {
    id: SourceId;
    sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId;
    displayName: MultilingualText;
    plain: PlainConfig;
    storedSecrets: string[];
    pollIntervalSeconds: number | null;
    shown: boolean;
    name: string | null;
    attributes: SourceAttribute[];
    health: SourceHealth;
    choices?: Record<string, KnownValue[]>;
};
export type SourceForm = {
    sourceTypeId: SourceTypeId;
    displayName: MultilingualText;
    fields: ConfigFieldSpec[];
    catalogue: {
        configKey: string;

            id: string;
            displayName: MultilingualText;
        }[];
    } | null;

};

    plain: PlainConfig;
    secrets: Record<string, string>;
    pollIntervalSeconds?: number | null;
};

    ok: false;
    problem: "invalid-interval";
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "invalid-config";
    fields: string[];
};
export type AddSourceResult = {
    ok: true;
    id: SourceId;
    setUp: boolean;
} | {
    ok: false;

    ok: false;
    problem: "setup-failed";
    message: string;
} | SourceProblem;
export type EditSourceResult = {
    ok: true;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "unknown-source" | "source-type-not-enabled";
} | SourceProblem;
export declare function createSourceAccess(deps: SourcesDeps): {
    list(): Promise<SourceSummary[]>;

        sourceTypeId: string;
    }): Promise<AddSourceResult>;
    edit(id: SourceId, input: SourceInput): Promise<EditSourceResult>;
    setShown(id: SourceId, shown: boolean): Promise<void>;
    rename(id: SourceId, name: string): Promise<{
        ok: true;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        problem: "invalid-name";
    }>;
    assignAttribute(id: SourceAttributeId, concerns: FamilyMemberId[]): Promise<{
        ok: true;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        problem: "unknown-attribute" | "unknown-member";
    }>;
    remove(id: SourceId): Promise<void>;
};
export type SourceAccess = ReturnType<typeof createSourceAccess>;

import { type Attribution, type FamilyLanguage, type FamilyMemberId, type ItemId, type LocalDate, type LocalTime, type MultilingualText, type RawMessageId, type TaskStatus, type TimeSpan, type TimetableChangeKind, type AgendaId, type AgendaLayout } from "@family-agenda/domain";

export type TimelineEvent = {

    until: LocalTime | null;

        allDay: true;
        firstDay: LocalDate;
        lastDay: LocalDate;

        allDay: false;
        start: LocalDateTime;
        end: LocalDateTime;
    };

    cancelled: boolean;
    earlier: boolean;

        url: string;

        id: RawMessageId;
        source: MultilingualText;

};

};

};

};

    }[];

};
export type AgendaFeed = {
    id: AgendaId;
    language: FamilyLanguage;
    generatedAt: Date;
    events: FeedEvent[];
    schoolDays: FeedSchoolDay[];

};
export declare const openAgendaAccess: AgendaAccessPolicy;
export declare function createAgendaAccess(deps: AgendasDeps): {
    messageItemRows(written: ProjectedItem[]): Promise<MessageItemRows>;
    list(): Promise<AgendaSummary[]>;
    create(input: AgendaSettingsInput): Promise<{
        ok: true;
        id: AgendaId;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        problem: AgendaProblem;
    }>;
    edit(id: AgendaId, input: AgendaSettingsInput): Promise<{
        ok: true;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        problem: AgendaProblem | "unknown-agenda";
    }>;
    remove(id: AgendaId): Promise<void>;
    open(id: AgendaId, input: {
        access: AgendaAccessPolicy;
        show?: Showing;
        days?: TimelineDays;
    }): Promise<AgendaPage | TaskListPage | null>;
    activity(id: AgendaId, input: {
        access: AgendaAccessPolicy;
    }): Promise<CurrentActivity | null | undefined>;
    feed(id: AgendaId, input: {
        access: AgendaAccessPolicy;
    }): Promise<AgendaFeed | null>;
};
